raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Diagnosing a real OOM-fix validation failure for `internlm/internlm3-8b-instruct` and `zai-org/chatglm2-6b` on Intel XPU surfaced two separate crashes in tokenizer handling that take down the whole detokenizer/scheduler process instead of failing gracefully for the one affected request.

## Modifications

- `DetokenizerManager`: both the batch (`_grouped_batch_decode`) and per-request decode paths called `tokenizer.decode()` with no guard against a custom `convert_tokens_to_string()` that assumes a non-empty token list. `skip_special_tokens=True` can legitimately filter every id out of a non-empty span, and some custom remote-code tokenizers (e.g. InternLM3's) raise `IndexError` on that instead of handling it. Added `_safe_decode()`, used by both paths, which returns `""` for that span instead of propagating.
- `patch_tokenizer.py`: some custom remote-code tokenizers (e.g. zai-org/chatglm2-6b's `ChatGLMTokenizer`) declare a fixed `_pad()` signature with no `padding_side` param and no `**kwargs`, predating newer `transformers` versions always forwarding `padding_side` down to `_pad()`. Every `tokenizer.encode()`/`pad()` call then raises `TypeError: ..._pad() got an unexpected keyword argument 'padding_side'`. Added a shim, following the existing Kimi tiktoken patch's pattern, that detects this structurally via `inspect` and drops the kwarg before delegating to the original `_pad()`.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable -- these are crash-recovery/compatibility fixes, not changes to model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable -- no impact on inference speed; the added logic only runs on an exception/signature-mismatch path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (See Accuracy/Speed Tests sections above -- not applicable to this fix.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Both crashes reproduced and confirmed fixed directly against the real installed tokenizers (InternLM3 and ChatGLM2) on real Intel XPU hardware via Docker.

+    if _needs_pad_padding_side_shim(tokenizer):

+def _needs_pad_padding_side_shim(tokenizer) -> bool:
+    pad_fn = getattr(type(tokenizer), "_pad", None)
+    if pad_fn is None:
+        return False
+    try:
+        sig = inspect.signature(pad_fn)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return False
+    params = sig.parameters
+    if "padding_side" in params:
+        return False
+    return not any(p.kind == inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for p in params.values())
+
+
 def unpatch_tokenizer(tokenizer):
     return _SpecialTokensCachePatcher.unpatch(tokenizer)
 
@@ -40,6 +59,29 @@ def decode_without_hf_kwargs(tokenizer, token_ids, skip_special_tokens):
     return tokenizer.decode(token_ids)
 
 
+class _PadPaddingSideShim:
+    _PATCHED_FLAG = "_sglang_pad_padding_side_patched"
+
+    @classmethod
+    def patch(cls, tokenizer):
+        tokenizer_cls = type(tokenizer)
+
+        if getattr(tokenizer_cls, cls._PATCHED_FLAG, False):
+            return tokenizer
+
+        original_pad = tokenizer_cls._pad
+
+        def patched_pad(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            kwargs.pop("padding_side", None)
+            return original_pad(self, *args, **kwargs)
+
+        tokenizer_cls._original_pad = original_pad
+        tokenizer_cls._pad = patched_pad
+        setattr(tokenizer_cls, cls._PATCHED_FLAG, True)
+
+        return tokenizer
+
+
 class _SpecialTokensCachePatcher:
     _PATCHED_FLAG = "_sglang_special_tokens_patched"
